settings.title: Bold, Not Precious
settings.body: Great fragrance should be bold, irreverent, and worth talking about, not something you hide in a drawer or save for a spa day.

settings.title: Handcrafted, For Real
settings.body: Real fragrance loads on a hand-rolled stick. No shortcuts, no synthetic filler dressed up as "essential."

settings.title: Just Wood, No Nonsense
settings.body: We burn wood: palo santo, agarwood. That's it. No extra nonsense, nothing in the stick that doesn't belong there.

settings.title: Built From A Note Pairing
settings.body: Each scent starts as a deliberate pairing of notes, not a mystery blend.

settings.title: Hand-Rolled Sticks
settings.body: Rolled by hand with a real fragrance load, so the room actually notices.

settings.title: ~50 Minutes A Burn
settings.body: Long enough to matter, short enough that you won't forget it's lit.
